description: This file defines a utility class 'Validators' containing static methods for common input validation tasks such as checking for empty strings, validating email format, password length, and positive number validation.

classes.name: Validators
classes.description: A class providing static methods for various input validation checks.

methods.name: notEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a given string is null or empty after trimming; returns an error message if invalid.

methods.name: email
methods.description: Validates that the input string is a properly formatted email address.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Ensures that the password is at least 6 characters long.

methods.name: positiveNumber
methods.description: Checks if the input string represents a number greater than zero.
